Gold Prices Expected to See Limited Upside Amid Inflation Concerns

Gold prices are anticipated to experience a limited upward trend in the coming week. This projection is influenced by high inflation rates observed in the United States. Analysts are monitoring key price levels for the week of July 6, 2026.
